facts.fact: According to the American Dental Association's practice economics research (cited by Adwave), a new dental patient represents $5,000-10,000+ in lifetime revenue.
facts.quote: represents $5,000-10,000+ in lifetime revenue, according to the American Dental Association's practice economics research

facts.fact: Adwave states that a dental practice's patient base typically comes from a radius of 10-15 miles in suburban areas.
facts.quote: typically 10-15 miles in suburban areas

facts.fact: According to research published in the British Dental Journal (as cited by Adwave), dental anxiety affects roughly 36% of the population.
facts.quote: Dental anxiety affects roughly 36% of the population, according to research published in the British Dental Journal.

facts.fact: Adwave states that connected TV (streaming) advertising CPMs average $15-35, meaning 1,000 local viewers cost $15-35.
facts.quote: CPMs average $15-35, meaning you reach 1,000 local viewers for $15-35.

facts.fact: Adwave says dental practices can launch a streaming TV advertising campaign starting at $30 a day, including creating a professional TV commercial.
facts.quote: launch a campaign starting at just $30 a day

facts.fact: Adwave states that Google search ads for dentists typically cost $5-15 per click, depending on the market.
facts.quote: You pay per click, typically $5-15 depending on your market.

facts.fact: Adwave states that Google search ads typically cost $1,000-3,000 per month for meaningful visibility in most dental markets.
facts.quote: Search ads typically cost $1,000-3,000/month for meaningful visibility in most dental markets.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a Google Business Profile listing is free.
facts.quote: Business Profile is free.

facts.fact: Adwave states that Facebook and Instagram ad CPMs run $8-15.
facts.quote: CPMs run $8-15.

facts.fact: Adwave states that monthly budgets of $500-1,500 on Facebook and Instagram produce meaningful results for most dental practices.
facts.quote: Monthly budgets of $500-1,500 produce meaningful results for most practices.

facts.fact: Adwave states that direct mail costs $0.50-1.50 per piece including design, printing, and postage.
facts.quote: $0.50-1.50 per piece including design, printing, and postage.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a 5,000-piece direct mail campaign for a dental practice runs $2,500-7,500.
facts.quote: A campaign of 5,000 pieces runs $2,500-7,500.

facts.fact: Adwave states that direct mail response rates for dental practices are typically 1-3%.
facts.quote: Response rates typically 1-3%

facts.fact: Adwave states that dental new patient acquisition peaks seasonally, with insurance plan changes in January, back-to-school check-ups in August, and year-end benefit rushes in November and December.
facts.quote: Insurance plan changes in January, back-to-school check-ups in August, and the year-end "use it or lose it" benefits rush in November and December

facts.fact: Yelp's basic profile is free, while enhanced listings and ads run $300-1,000 per month depending on the market, according to the vendor's guide.
facts.quote: Free for basic profile. Enhanced listings and ads run $300-1,000/month depending on your market.

facts.fact: The vendor's guide says referral program rewards typically cost $25-75 per successful referral in credits or gifts.
facts.quote: Reward cost per referral, typically $25-75 in credits or gifts.

facts.fact: The vendor's guide says a local community sponsorship costs $500-5,000 depending on scale and visibility.
facts.quote: $500-5,000 per sponsorship depending on scale and visibility.

facts.fact: The vendor's guide says hiring an SEO agency for a dental practice runs $1,000-3,000 per month.
facts.quote: Hiring an SEO agency runs $1,000-3,000/month.

facts.fact: The vendor's guide says outsourced content creation costs $200-500 per blog post.
facts.quote: Content creation costs $200-500 per blog post if outsourced.

facts.fact: The vendor's guide says local SEO takes 6-12 months to produce meaningful organic results.
facts.quote: Takes 6-12 months to see meaningful organic results

facts.fact: The vendor's guide says radio airtime in small to mid-size markets runs $200-1,500 per week depending on frequency and station popularity.
facts.quote: Airtime in small to mid-size markets runs $200-1,500/week depending on frequency and station popularity.

facts.fact: The vendor's guide says radio production costs range from free (station-produced) to $500+ for professional production.
facts.quote: Production costs range from free (station-produced) to $500+ for professional production.

facts.fact: The vendor's guide says radio ads typically run 30 or 60 seconds.
facts.quote: Ads typically run 30 or 60 seconds during specific dayparts

facts.fact: The vendor's guide says radio has strong reach among audiences aged 40 and older.
facts.quote: Strong reach among older demographics (40+)

facts.fact: The vendor's guide says Google Business Profile is free.
facts.quote: Google Business Profile is free and essential.

facts.fact: The vendor's guide says Google Search Ads cost $5-15 per click in most dental markets.
facts.quote: Google Search Ads capture high-intent patients but cost more per lead ($5-15 per click in most dental markets).

facts.fact: The vendor's guide says streaming TV advertising campaigns start at $50.
facts.quote: streaming TV advertising offers the best value for building broad awareness, with campaigns starting at $50.

facts.fact: The vendor's guide cites ADA Health Policy Institute benchmarks suggesting dental practices spend 3-8% of revenue on marketing; this is a third-party benchmark as attributed by the vendor.
facts.quote: Industry benchmarks suggest 3-8% of revenue for dental marketing, according to the ADA Health Policy Institute.

facts.fact: The vendor's guide gives an example that a practice generating $800,000 annually would spend $24,000-64,000 per year on advertising at the 3-8% benchmark.
facts.quote: For a practice generating $800,000 annually, that's $24,000-64,000 per year.

facts.fact: AdWave says its streaming TV advertising for dental practices starts at $30 a day.
facts.quote: start reaching local patients on premium streaming channels, starting at just $30 a day.

facts.fact: AdWave offers a free first commercial for dental practices creating their first TV ad on its platform.
facts.quote: Create your first commercial free
